recipes.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production environment illustration for HUMAN OVERRIDE, a polished dark sci-fi anime tactical action game. Create a wide cinematic landscape, 1536x1024 or wider. ECLIPSE RELAY: a deserted orbital communications harbor high over the blue crescent of Earth, a huge eclipsed sun surrounded by a thin pale-gold corona in the black sky. Three elegant gigantic satellite relay towers connected by broad gunmetal landing decks, cyan signal conduits, gold solar panels. A small command platform in the foreground, dramatic depth toward the eclipsed sun. Sophisticated mechanical architecture, restrained atmospheric glow, crisp detailed cel-painted anime background art, premium Japanese sci-fi game aesthetic. No people, no text, no logos, no UI. Readable silhouettes, complex original architecture. The intended use is campaign selection artwork and narrative CG, not a navigable painted game map. Deliver one finished scene.

Use case: stylized-concept. One finished production animation sprite sheet for a new boss in HUMAN OVERRIDE, a dark anime sci-fi action game. HELIO JUDGE, an original levitating orbital sentinel: circular black eclipse core encased in white titanium armor, segmented pale gold solar halo, four articulated mechanical fins, cyan sensors, heavy purposeful construction. True three-quarter overhead game perspective, front consistently toward image bottom, NO sideways rotation. Exactly 8 isolated poses arranged in a strict 4-column 2-row equal-cell grid, wide 2048x1024 canvas. Same machine, same palette, same scale and consistent centered registration every cell. Readable silhouette with large generous empty margins per cell, absolutely no part entering another cell. Row1: closed idle; slightly expanded hover; fins raised charging; open radiant core charging. Row2: fins wide firing; recoil after firing; damaged core with cracks; collapsed broken debris with dark cooling core. Crisp detailed hand-painted cel-rendered game art, restrained soft emission, no pixelation, no scenery, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no ground shadows. Genuine transparent alpha background; do not paint checkerboards. If transparency cannot be produced use perfectly flat pure magenta #ff00ff outside all isolated silhouettes to allow deterministic extraction. Produce the whole strip together.

Use case: stylized-concept. One finished wide cinematic campaign scene for HUMAN OVERRIDE, dark premium sci-fi anime game background art. Original sophisticated architecture, exquisite detailed cel-painted anime environment, dark navy metals, cool cyan light, warm amber highlights, cinematic atmospheric perspective, composed as narrative key art. 1536x1024 landscape. No text, logos, UI, or close-up people. Produce one scene.

Use case: stylized-concept. One production game sprite sheet for CHRONO LEVIATHAN, original boss of a dark sci-fi anime action game. An imposing hovering armored mechanical manta-whale, broad compact silhouette, navy titanium plates, two swept side fins bearing heavy rail cannons, luminous cyan gravity spine, bronze vents, short segmented tail. Distinct from a dragon. 3/4 overhead view with head toward image bottom in ALL cells, consistent same identity, palette, scale and centered anchor. Bottom row: both rail cannons firing short controlled cyan muzzle flash; recoiling with vents dimming; armor damaged and cracked core; collapsed ruined machine with dim debris. Detailed crisp cel-painted premium sci-fi sprite illustration, no pixels, no scenery, no text, no numbers, no grid lines, no shadows. Genuine transparent alpha background, never painted checkerboard. A single consistent whole-sheet generation, with all eight full-body poses completely inside their cells.
